tools.name: read_company_profile
tools.description: Returns one firm's public profile by its slug: name, trade, region, services, languages, descriptions, sources, the profile and agent-file links, and contact: whether the firm takes messages and which kinds of request (contact.intents).

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "confirm_listing" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_companies, read_company_profile · Private data: read_company_profile, send_contact_request, request_listing · Public sink: send_contact_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_companies, read_company_profile · Private data: read_company_profile, send_contact_request, request_listing · Public sink: send_contact_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_companies" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
